record.explanation: Vitamin K is needed to make several proteins involved in hemostasis, including prothrombin. The NIH Office of Dietary Supplements identifies bleeding and hemorrhage as characteristic signs of severe vitamin K deficiency, linking this vitamin to the clotting process asked about.
